== Published English Original Virtual Set 9 wording ==
The recovered original places this Effect in Used Pile to cancel a weapon target. The 9 November 2005 issuer change places it in Lost Pile and limits the cancel to a character weapon. The remaster charges 2 Force, draws a Used Pile card, limits Rebel eligibility, lowers the immunity threshold, removes the Imperial deploy modifier and uses an out-of-play cost at a same or related site.
